segments.text: What unsettles viewers here isn't excess, but restraint.
segments.englishExplanation: Viewers are unsettled not by too much on display, but by how much the artist deliberately holds back.
segments.turkishExplanation: Burada izleyicileri tedirgin eden şey fazlalık değil, ölçülülüktür.

segments.text: The emptiness feels almost deliberate. It is.
segments.englishExplanation: The empty space seems intentional, and indeed, it was planned that way on purpose.
segments.turkishExplanation: Boşluk hissi neredeyse kasti gibi duruyor. Zaten öyle.

segments.text: The void does the heavy lifting, the artist withholds so you fill in the rest.
segments.englishExplanation: The empty space carries most of the impact because the artist holds back details, prompting the viewer to imagine the rest.
segments.turkishExplanation: Bütün ağır yükü o boşluk sırtlıyor; sanatçı kendini geri çekiyor ki geri kalanını siz tamamlayasınız.

learningPoints.englishExplanation: An idiom meaning to do the most difficult, substantial, or impactful part of a task.
learningPoints.turkishExplanation: Bir işin en zor, en zahmetli veya asıl etkiyi yaratan kısmını üstlenmek anlamına gelen yaygın bir deyim.
learningPoints.exampleEn: I gathered the initial data, but my partner did the heavy lifting on the final report.
learningPoints.exampleTr: İlk verileri ben topladım ama nihai raporun asıl ağır yükünü ortağım sırtladı.

quiz.question: In the video, what does the speaker mean by saying that 'the void does the heavy lifting'?

options.text: The empty space creates the primary emotional impact of the piece.
The physical structure relies on hollow materials for balance.
The lack of detail makes the work much easier for the artist to complete.
The audience is expected to ignore the missing parts of the artwork.
